project.name: Baobab ERP Events Bundle
project.description: Subscribes to iDempiere's own OSGi EventAdmin model-change events (the standard org.osgi.service.event.EventHandler contract iDempiere's AbstractEventHandler is built on) and, on a real C_BPartner/M_Product/C_Order/C_Invoice create/update (ADR-ERP-007 section 170's near-term mapping-matrix slice), derives the owning tenant from the changed record's own AD_Client_ID/AD_Org_ID via the registered ContextResolver service, then calls CanonicalMappingResolver to resolve its canonical identity (ADR-ERP-007). Deriving the tenant per record (rather than assuming one tenant per process) matters because ADR-ERP-003's default topology (ERP_SHARED_INSTANCE_DEDICATED_CLIENT) has one iDempiere runtime hosting several AD_Clients at once. Hooks the asynchronous PO_POST_CREATE/PO_POST_UPADTE topics specifically because they fire after the triggering transaction has committed, so the resulting blocking HTTP calls to baobab-app never run inside a document transaction (ADR-ERP-004, INV-ERP-EXT-011).
